استقطرت (form X)

# اِسْتَقْطَرْتَ (istaqṭarta) /is.taq.tˤar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# اِسْتَقْطَرْتِ (istaqṭarti) /is.taq.tˤar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# اِسْتَقْطَرَتْ (istaqṭarat) /i
